instruction: Walk across kitchen, turn left and stop under the stairs.

steps.thought: I'm in the kitchen facing the stove and windows. I'll walk forward across the kitchen toward the glass door area, then look for the stairs to turn left toward.
I'm in the kitchen facing the counter; the walkway continues ahead past the glass doors. I'll advance along the kitchen, then look for the stairs to turn left.
I'm in the kitchen beside a large stove, with glass doors ahead. I'll advance along the counter toward the doors, then look for the stairs to turn left.
I'm in the kitchen facing the glass doors. I need to cross the kitchen and find the stairs; I'll turn left to scan the room for the staircase.
I'm facing a kitchen counter up close; the walkable path appears to be to the right toward the glass doors. I'll turn right and re-observe before moving.
I'm facing a kitchen counter blocking my path. I need to turn right to find the open floor of the kitchen and head toward the stairs.
I'm facing a kitchen counter with no path forward. I need to turn right to look back across the kitchen toward the stairs area.
I've exited the kitchen area and can see the staircase on the right side of the open living space. I need to walk toward it and stop under the stairs.
The staircase is visible ahead-right across the open floor. I'll advance toward it and then stop under the stairs.
The staircase is visible ahead to the right; I should approach it and stop beneath it.
The staircase is directly ahead and I am already at its base, which is 'under the stairs'. I should stop here.
